name: Kirameki Kirara
source:
"Everyone, [b]Kon-Kira![/b] It's your Kemomimi Performer, [b]Kirameki Kirara![/b]"

[url=/c138329]Runa[/url]'s [b]virtual Performer[/b]'s avatar, she makes her debut on July 7. The avatar has the appearance of a lion girl, short stature with a child body, the exact opposite of Runa. Basically, the adorable thing that she yearns to be.

Her name literally means "Sparkling."

*"Kon-Kira" is possibly a combined of "Kon"banwa and her name "Kirara."
